purpose: Test whether fresh CPU-driven optional reads prevent the repeated receive-DMA overrun that stops cache production, while measuring the resulting serialized CPU cost.

motivating_capture.name: 63369.mp4
motivating_capture.retained_exits: FIRST and LAST are POLL/OVERRUN; unrepaired1 with a previous loss already recorded in current area1.

candidate_policy.entry: Controller-completion heartbeat TICK only, through the existing serialized private-stack auxiliary gateway.
candidate_policy.work_limit: At most one fresh physical512B block per eligible heartbeat, followed by CRC validation and cache append during the same visit.
candidate_policy.transport: Existing SCI CPU-driven polled receive path: fetch(next,256,true) only from PAUSED at the exact next cache LBA.
admission: No active, pending, executing or failed demand request
No VMU loan, closed reader, unacquired or faulted port
No busy receiver, deferred reception or owned speculative job
Valid cache capacity and exact mapped-extent bounds
Already-open card stream PAUSED at the next physical block
Existing guest DMA1/global-DMA idle predicate passes
not_admitted: GD DELIVER or SCI IRQ producer fetch
candidate_policy.timeout_note: Existing per-byte register-poll timeouts are retained. Bounded byte work is not a strict millisecond guarantee; producer-only elapsed time is captured.
candidate_policy.cache_publication: Only after the existing complete block CRC check; failures abandon optional work without failing an unrelated guest request.

producer_timing.storage: Previously unused diagnostics.stage_result[NONE][0..2]; failure histogram rows1..6 are unchanged.
values: Largest valid producer-only duration in existing TMU0 ticks
excludes: Heartbeat seed scan and admission checks
producer_timing.clock_validation: Existing FRQCR/TMU profile at both endpoints, with unsigned elapsed delta below0x80000000; invalid samples do not update maximum.
producer_timing.capture_start: Gesture resets metrics, normal statistics and exit records while preserving valid cached data.

software_validation.contention_case: 32 eligible heartbeats append32 CRC-checked blocks with repeated DMA-overrun injections388/458 still armed and channel2 active; no optional DMAC register writes, no DMA starts, no additional CMD18/CMD12, no overrun/CRC/token/abandon errors.
software_validation.admission_cases: GD, IRQ, TICK-in-IRQ, active/pending/executing demand, loan, busy DMA, RESUME/LOST/position mismatch refuse optional byte work.
software_validation.failure_cases: CRC and token rejection, first/middle/last byte bus faults, latched-fault suppression and cache/full/extent boundaries preserve guest-request status and never publish an unchecked block.
software_validation.token_bound_cases: Successful last-token-byte case uses770 byte callbacks; no-token rejection uses256.
software_validation.timing_cases: Attempt/max/invalid metric scope, invalid clocks, elapsed wrap and capture reset covered.

hardware_test.workload: Same Evolution2 new-game in-engine opening and movement area; also verify FMVs.
hardware_test.capture: Both triggers plus B for about1second, release and continue moving until the intentional approximately20second stop. Record25seconds from CRC VALIDATED PHYSICAL READ AHEAD through the next LOADER TIMELINE heading.
hardware_test.first_discriminator: Does optional production continue without repeated aborts?
hardware_test.second_discriminator: How much serialized producer time buys how many checked blocks and cached-request feeds?
remaining_limits: One512B block per60Hz heartbeat has a30KiB/s ideal ceiling; at50Hz it is25KiB/s.
A cold or unpredicted request still uses the original demand reader.
Counters alone do not prove every rendered hitch cause.

throughput_control.meaning: The recent eight reads alone exceed one-block-per-heartbeat ideal production; this first control tests completion and cost, and should provide partial warming rather than guarantee fully cached bursts. More requests may precede the retained recent eight.
